    • evaluatedPoints

      private static List<Double> evaluatedPoints(Function<MultiDimensionFunctionEvaluatorListener,GradientEstimator> factory, double x) throws EvaluationException
      Gets the first coordinate of the points where a function is evaluated when estimating the gradient at provided value.
